hypothesis: Running a first model call to brainstorm raw question candidates, then a second call to select and phrase the best 7, should outperform single-shot generation because separating ideation from editorial judgment lets each pass specialise.
technique: A two-call on-device pipeline: the first FM call freely brainstorms candidate questions, and the second FM call selects and phrases the final 7 from that candidate pool — splitting generation from selection/phrasing across two sequential model calls.
